items.descMs: Kempen penuh. Mulakan dengan sebuah kuala sungai di Selat Melaka dan bina tamadun merentasi empat era.
items.descEn: The full campaign. Start at a river mouth on the Straits of Melaka and build a civilisation across all four eras.
objectivesEn: Build an entrepôt harbour and a market

items.descMs: Bandar perlombongan yang pesat dengan lombong di kaki bukit dan pelabuhan kapal wap. Tiada landasan kereta api lagi: hubungkan lombong ke laut!
items.descEn: A booming mining town with foothill mines and a steamship port, but no railway yet: link the mines to the sea!
objectivesMs: Selidik Kereta Api dan bina landasan dari lombong ke pelabuhan
Capai 5,000 penduduk dan Stesen Besar Moorish
objectivesEn: Research Railways and lay track from the mines to the port
Reach 5,000 people and the Grand Moorish Station

items.descMs: Bandar perindustrian era Merdeka dengan kilang, janakuasa dan pelabuhan kontena. Peralihan ke ekonomi digital bermula.
items.descEn: A Merdeka-era industrial city with factories, power and a container port. The shift to the digital economy begins.
objectivesMs: Bina Hab Inovasi dan Pusat Data
objectivesEn: Build an Innovation Hub and a Data Centre
Earn the Smart Nation Pioneer milestone
